name: fx-send-receive
title: FX Send Receive
description: Send/receive pair for international transfers. Locks the side you typed, works out the other from rate and fees, compares what arrives with the invoice, and flags the invoice typed into "You send", a currency mismatch, SHA deductions and overpaying, with one-tap fixes.

meta.stops: Helps prevent an invoice being paid short after fees
mistakes: typed amount in you send instead of they receive
meta.summary: Helps an international payment arrive in full: it measures what the recipient actually gets against the invoice, after fees and bank deductions.
meta.server: Re-quote the rate and fees on the server and charge against that server quote, with an idempotency key on the transfer.
catches: Invoice amount typed into "You send" instead of "They receive"
Invoice in a different currency from the receiving side
SHA charges that intermediary banks may deduct on the way
Fixes: lock "They receive" at the exact amount, or switch charges to OUR
limits: Arithmetic on the quote you pass in; it does not fetch live rates or fees
Intermediary deductions are an estimate from your quote's maximum, not what banks will actually take
Does not check the recipient's account details or sanctions screening
a11y: Both amount fields have visible labels; the receive field gets aria-invalid when a warning applies
Charges choice is a radiogroup with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation
Status line uses role=status; decorative icons are aria-hidden
Focus moves to the receive field after a fix that changes it
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
